author: operator
summary: Answer the local model question and mark the branch ready for review.
operator_message: Use vLLM first because it is OpenAI-compatible and works well for shared GPU runners; keep Ollama as a fallback for Mac mini clusters.

questions.question: Which local model runner should be the first candidate?
questions.answer: Use vLLM first; keep Ollama as the fallback local-provider route.

decisions.title: Keep source plan immutable
decisions.decision: This branch uses a new plan_id and records the original plan as source_plan_id.
decisions.rationale: A separate durable plan prevents revised branch details from overwriting prior plan history.

decisions.title: Use vLLM first
decisions.decision: Prefer vLLM for the branch's first local model runner because it exposes an OpenAI-compatible API and maps cleanly to runner capabilities.
decisions.rationale: The coordinator can route through the same model-provider contract while preserving local-model optionality.
